title: Ridealive Japan Returns on November 7-8th 2026 in Shizuoka Prefecture
content:
Ridealive is Nagoya, Japan-based Circles‘ weekend bike camping ride event, started in 2014. After a seven-year hiatus, it returns this year, November 7-8, 2026, to Yaizu City, Shizuoka Prefecture. Each day’s events are staged around different campsites, and attendees must pick their own route between campgrounds. An event ticket ($118) gets you meals, beverages, campsites, and other accommodations and can be purchased online at Circles or in person at Circles. Check out more event information on the Ridealive 2026 webpage.

We’ll be in attendance to help celebrate Circles’ 20th anniversary, so be sure to say hello!

Kudos on the flyer design, which is by @sabotenstudio (@joshuaminnich)
